text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Fan Fest, where the
students put on
various events and
interact with their fans.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
We've completed our security check of
the area, Your Highness. There are no
immediate concerns,
so we'll remain on
standby around the perimeter.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. But... is this really
okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Normally, there's no way they would let
Fine
Motion take part in an event like
this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her popularity continues to grow after the
accomplishments of her classic year.
In an event packed with fans like this,
her safety can't be
guaranteed. But...

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
You're saying that you wish for Her
Highness to
participate no matter what?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A short time back, I spoke to her
security captain directly in the hopes of
getting permission for Fine Motion to
participate. For her sake, I thought it
was absolutely necessary.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
I respect Her Highness from the bottom
of my
heart. That's why I follow her
wishes. Which is
why...
choice_data_list: I don't want you getting used to b...

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
I'll try to convince our security HQ.
Can I
count
on your cooperation?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It turned out my "cooperation" meant
negotiating with their headquarters as a
representative of the
academy. Luckily,
we were able to get permission.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You must have worked very diligently on
my
behalf, Trainer. You have my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And you as well, Captain. Good work.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
My role is to safeguard your academy
life, Your Highness. As such, my pride
will not allow me to
let you miss out on
participating.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, is that right? I'm truly grateful to
you both.

text_block_list.name: Academy Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Our next contest is the Running Quiz!

Participating students, please head to
the
assigned area.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's about to begin! I'll be off,
then!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion!
Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Running Quiz begins amid
the
raucous cheers of the fans.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion is in first place without a
single
mistake so far! Now, for your final
question!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
There's a song from a famous musical
that begins
with the word "doe." What
does that "doe" mean
in English?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Oh, an English question!
That's a gimme!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Doe.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Do-re-miii-re-do,
do-re-mi-re-do-reee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, I've bungled it.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
So, uh...
She was totally just singing that
ramen
tune, right?!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Umm, actually... that is completely
incorrect. Bad
luck!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. I just started singing that song
without
realizing. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion marches to the beat of her
own
drum, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While she may have got the answer
wrong, Fine
Motion certainly succeeded
in creating a buzz
among the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
There's a ramen shop located at the
north exit of
the station called Raging
Storm. Where did the
owner fir—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The answer is Ikebukuro!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Holy cow!
She didn't even hear the
whole question!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The rest of the question was likely,
"Where did
the owner first learn his
craft?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Originally, he trained at two shops:
Stormy Soup
and Raging Ramen.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
He mainly learned the ins and outs of 
management at Stormy Soup and how to cook
ramen at Raging Ramen. Therefore,
the correct
answer is Ikebukuro!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Spot on! Fine Motion nailed it! That was
a really tough question made to trip up
even die-hard
ramen lovers, and you
made it seem easy!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The names of the shops also provided a
hint! He
took "raging" from one and
"storm" from the
other! ♪

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Rame...
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion is a force to be reckoned
with—her love and knowledge of ramen
both run deep... Could she be the next
Commodore Perry come to shake up the
ramen world?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion did a great job at the quiz,

thoroughly entertaining the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Whew! I'm so hot! It was just a light jog!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, they certainly are...
choice_data_list: The fans' energy was incredible, a...

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Gooo, Fine Motion!
Yeah, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You can do it, Fine!
Go for it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I could hear them calling my name so
much more
clearly than before.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...But why do they cheer for me so
eagerly?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You mean...
choice_data_list: Because I'm completely in love wit...

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: U-um! Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: I... want to thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But why?

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text:
It's because you make running look so
fun! Thank
you for that!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text:
I never even considered that you could
have fun racing. I thought that was
something only the
most skilled racers
were allowed to do.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text:
But when I watch you run, it's like
something
inside me has been set free.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text:
I see you and I think it looks so
nice—like racing
must be so fun.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text:
I want to run just like you.
It's like I've
been struck
by inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text:
I'm not very good yet, but I want to run
as
powerfully and beautifully as you one
day!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...It's peculiar. All I've been doing is
having fun.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's like I'm living in a delightful
dream. And like
any dream, this time will surely
end. Which is why I want to enjoy my
time here to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's all it is. And yet,
the fans call out
my name.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And there are those who wish to run as I
do...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I've begun to wish that I could stay here
forever. I
want to continue racing long,
long after I've
crossed my finish line.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even though I know there's no such thing
as
forever.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I won't find myself here again...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I know that. That's why—
choice_data_list: An end comes to everyone eventually.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the young Umamusume demonstrated
just now in the way she looks up to Fine
Motion, feelings
linger and memories
live on in people's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How can you say so with such
confidence? I'm
certain everyone will
forget all about me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just as the scent of perfume fades away.
Am I the
only one who will carry these
memories?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That duty... is to become a pillar of
Ireland's
prosperity.
choice_data_list: If it can become a "cornerstone" i...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There are certain concessions required
of my
heart... but a pillar I shall become.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no doubt that's important to her.
However, these concessions are also
there to protect her
from having to
sacrifice her feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She can be a role model that runners in
the Twinkle Series will always look up
to... someone who inspires such fervent
memories the fans pass down the stories
for generations!
choice_data_list: As the foundation of the Twinkle S...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: Let's leave an impact worthy of th...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're a surprisingly rash individual. We
have no
assured method with which to
make such an
impact.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If I could truly accomplish that... If I
could remain
in everyone's hearts... I
would be exceedingly
happy.
choice_data_list: Still, that way, you won't be lonely.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Would I happen to find myself in
residence there?
choice_data_list: It's a shame I can't show you what...
It's a shame I can't show you what...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, is that right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I hope I'm smiling in there. And I hope
that I'm
running heaps.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Yes,
that's right. The only way to leave
the
impression I want is to enter races.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We'll ascertain everything at the
Takarazuka
Kinen.
